newsitem.title: UK: U.K. Intervention Board details EU sugar sales.
newsitem.headline: U.K. Intervention Board details EU sugar sales.

text.p: A total 129,500 tonnes of current series white sugar received export rebates of a maximum 44.837 European Currency Units (Ecus) per 100 kilos at Wednesday's European Union (EU) tender, the U.K. Intervention Board said.
Out of this, traders in Germany received 43,250 tonnes, in France 42,000 the U.K. 21,000, in Belgium 12,000 and in Denmark 10,000, in Finland 1,000 and Spain 250 tonnes, it added.
Earlier on Wednesday, London traders had expected the subsidy to be avove 43.00 Ecus per 100 kilos.

Traders had also forecast Wednesday's total authorised sugar tonnage export awards to be between 60,000 and 100,000 tonnes versus 93,500 last week when the restitution was 43.392 Ecus. -- London Newsroom +44 171 542 8075
